notes.goal: Build an agentic pipeline that generates a Python chart, executes it, visually reflects on the output using a multimodal LLM, and refines the code to improve the chart.

nodes.label: Reflect and Critique
nodes.note: Multimodal LLM reviews image and code

nodes.label: Execute Code V2
nodes.note: Run refined script to save chart_v2.png

steps.title: Setup and Dataset Loading
steps.what_happens: Imports standard libraries and loads the coffee sales dataset into a pandas DataFrame, checking a random sample to understand its schema.

steps.title: Generate Initial Code (V1)
steps.what_happens: Prompts an LLM to write Python code using matplotlib that answers the user's request and wraps the code inside <execute_python> tags.

steps.title: Execute Code and Create V1 Chart
steps.what_happens: Extracts the Python code snippet from the LLM response via regular expressions, executes it against the DataFrame, and saves the resulting image as chart_v1.png.

steps.title: Reflect on Output
steps.what_happens: Sends the generated chart image and original code to a multimodal LLM to critique readability, missing data alignment, and labels, returning JSON feedback and revised code.

steps.title: Execute Improved Code (V2)
steps.what_happens: Extracts the newly refined code from the reflection step, executes it to fix data handling issues, and renders the polished chart_v2.png.

notes.results: All code cells executed successfully without errors. The workflow correctly generated the first draft chart, spotted missing data index alignment through visual reflection, and produced an improved V2 chart.
try_next: Change the user instructions to plot a different relationship, such as top-selling coffee types by revenue.
Switch the reflection model to a different LLM like Claude to compare critique styles.
Modify the hard constraints in the reflection prompt to enforce a specific color palette.
